toc: false
listing:
  id: all-projects
  contents: "*/index.qmd"
  sort: "date desc"
  template: ../_ejs/project-card.ejs
include-after-body:

      <script src="../assets/home.js"></script>
---

```{=html}
<!-- The numbers are fallbacks: scripts/update-stats.ts rewrites them at render
     time from the projects/*/index.qmd front matter, so they can't drift as
     projects are added, un-featured, or re-categorized. -->
<div class="nw-stats nw-statstrip">
<div class="nw-stat"><b data-nw-stat="project-total">17</b><span>Projects</span></div>
<div class="nw-stat"><b data-nw-stat="project-featured">6</b><span>Featured Projects</span></div>
<div class="nw-stat"><b data-nw-stat="project-categories">6</b><span>Topic Areas</span></div>
<div class="nw-stat"><b data-nw-stat="project-latest">2026</b><span>Latest Release</span></div>
</div>
```
